summary: HSBC Holdings plc (NYSE: HSBC) filed a 6-K disclosing daily repurchases under its buy-back programme announced 5 August 2026, executed by BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC as riskless principal. On 15 September 2026 HSBC bought 3,676,883 ordinary shares of US$0.50 on UK venues at a volume-weighted average of US$15.1643 per share, and 580,000 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$160.9470. Cumulative repurchases since commencement total 33,788,697 shares for approximately US$696.6 million, with shares cancelled. No board recommendation or advisor named.
